picks.editorial_note: An MIT-led team secured up to $53 million from ARPA-H to use generative AI for discovering safer next-generation herbicide alternatives — a major federal bet on AI-driven agrochemical discovery with direct public-health and agricultural stakes.
picks.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers

picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC's WorldParticle model unifies simulation of wildly different physical phenomena — from sliding sand to protein folding — in a single deep-learning framework, a genuine step toward general-purpose physics AI with broad scientific utility.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: CSIRO's ML-based imaging technique independently confirmed the landmark 2019 Event Horizon Telescope black hole image and was published in Nature, an important cross-validation of a historic astrophysics result using AI methods.
picks.title: New CSIRO technique confirms iconic black hole image

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and Carnegie Mellon's new 'Workspace Models' give robots a way to recall relevant past observations without expensive re-processing, addressing a core bottleneck in robot learning and manipulation.
picks.title: A new form of memory helps robots learn complex skills

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership to push physical AI, agentic AI, and robotics research into sovereign industrial applications signals a significant national-level push to translate French AI research into deployed industry capability.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics firm Unitree, aimed at a joint laboratory for embodied AI and robotics, pairs leading academic research with one of the most prominent commercial robotics companies, a notable academia-industry bridge in a fast-moving field.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Science Tokyo's ZEBRA-Prop method lightens the computational cost of predicting material properties from natural-language descriptions, a practical advance for AI-accelerated materials discovery done in collaboration with Yokohama City and Tohoku universities.
picks.title: 言語モデルを用いた材料物性の予測を軽量化 | Science Tokyo - 東京科学大学

picks.editorial_note: Northeastern's analysis of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's reported ties to a suspected Chinese espionage case raises real national-security questions about the AI chip supply chain, with potential policy ramifications for US-China tech competition.
picks.title: Nvidia CEO’s scandal raises questions about US national security

picks.editorial_note: SMU's $4.2 million NIST award to build a Digital Twin Technology Lab combines AI, robotics, and HPC to advance domestic semiconductor manufacturing and workforce training, tying directly into national chip-supply priorities.
picks.title: SMU awarded $4.2 million to advance AI-driven manufacturing and workforce training

picks.editorial_note: A $5 million multi-institutional NSF grant led by the University of Georgia will build an open radio access network testbed to optimize wireless infrastructure for extended reality applications, a meaningful investment in AI-adjacent networking research.
picks.title: $5M NSF grant to grow extended reality technologies
